title: From Caricature to Collective Artifact: How Persona Construction Drives Polarization in Generative Social Simulations

bias_targets.methodology: Ablating political identity markers (affective polarization, party identification, and voting behavior) in LLM-generated personas and measuring the resulting impact on political homophily, affective polarization (via feeling thermometer gaps), partisan trait attribution, and cross-party follow rates within a simulated social network.
